programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The concluding part of a two-part documentary series. Detectives raid Luke D'Wit's home and seize a huge stash of prescription drugs - including fentanyl and antihistamine - that are both found in the Baxters' postmortem as police press Luke to explain his relationship to Carol Baxter's mysterious American physician Dr Andrea Bowden. Luke has been mixing 'medicinal' drinks for Carol on Dr Bowden's instructions, but detectives can find no trace of her existence - meanwhile, Ellena Baxter is completely cleared of her parents' murders and agrees to be interviewed as a witness for the police. As Ellena slowly realises that Luke has been a cuckoo in the family nest, detectives spend months combing through D'Wit's multiple digital devices to piece together the scale of his deception and cruelty.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. Raheel Ahmad looked the perfect match for TikTok photographer Sania Khan on paper - he came from a good family and wanted to be a doctor, but Raheel couldn't pass his medical exams once the couple had gotten married and then tried to hurl himself and her from the window of their 28th-storey Chicago apartment just months after their huge wedding. Hospitalised with mental problems, Raheel admitted that he had lied about his age and had been unfaithful - Sania then went public on TikTok with her agonies over whether to stick by her man or request a divorce. Her honesty and growing self-reliance resonated with abused women around the world and sent shockwaves through the South Asian community in America - the couple separated, but Raheel started to plot his revenge as Sania's posts went viral.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: Fern Britton joins much-loved pets and their devoted owners behind the scenes at The Grove Vets, a busy family practice in the suburbs of Bristol run by husband-and-wife team Andy and Amy Valencia - in this episode, Fern helps the team as they manage a busy few days of operations and consultations. Vet James is concerned about British Shorthair cat Nico as he has a limp in his hind legs, Fern meets Cocker Spaniel Nya as she enters the surgery for a scan on a potentially cancerous lump, vet Amy is in theatre and performing an operation on Border Terrier Dobby to remove an undescended testicle, nervous Cockapoo Jobo has to undergo an operation to have a lump removed from his ear by vet Andy, and we head outside the practice to Bristol's Guide Dog Centre to see puppies in training.

programme.title: From Russia with Love
programme.desc: The second entry in the James Bond spy film franchise and also the second movie to star Sean Connery as the fictional MI6 agent. 007 is on the search for a Russian decoding machine known as Lektor and needs to find this machine before the evil SPECTRE organisation discovers it. While being romantically linked with Russian Tatiana Romanova, James sneaks his way around Istanbul as SPECTRE agents - including the overpowering Donald 'Red' Grant and ex-KGB agent Rosa Klebb - try to pick him off.

Her honesty and growing self-reliance resonated with abused women around the world and sent shockwaves through the South Asian community in America - the couple separated, but Raheel started to plot his revenge as Sania's posts went viral.

programme.title: Syd
programme.desc: Syd is the inspirational story of a man who never backed down from a challenge. As a cricketer, David 'Syd' Lawrence was a fearsome fast bowler, who reached the top of the game to become the first British-born Black player to represent England. Although his career was cut short by an injury, described as one of the worst in sporting history, his achievements off the field have to be seen to be believed. In this film by Sabet Choudhury, Syd's family and friends including Phil Tufnell, Jonathan Agnew, Jack Russell and Sir Viv Richards recount a story that shows what can be achieved with a strong will and pure determination.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: In Donegal Town, Dermot's journey takes him further south along the Wild Atlantic Way, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its beautifully flecked fabric. Dressed fit for a fine meal, Dermot visits one of Ireland's most unexpected culinary hotspots: Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house. He meets Bangladeshi-born chef Rana, and together they cook railway curry using outstanding local Donegal lamb and potatoes - it's a heaven-made match of Asian flavours and quality Irish produce. For pudding, Dermot meets chef Brian McDermott, one of the biggest champions of Donegal's food scene. Together they bake a classic Irish apple pie, with Brian revealing why all the local rain creates richer grass, creamier milk and extra buttery pastry, making Donegal Town a dessert destination.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue is joined by old friend Raymond Blanc as he cooks a chocolate mousse - he calls it 'Maman Blanc' as it's a recipe that came from his mother. It's also a cheesecake day for Prue as she makes a Basque burnt cheesecake and a no-bake lemon and ginger cheesecake. Prue's food hero this time is Bold Beans and a farmer who produces some of the peas for the company - Prue and John then use some of those peas to make Indian pancakes with a carlin pea saag and paneer, and John is very happy that Prue has saved him some cheesecake and some of Raymond's chocolate mousse! While John heads to Tewkesbury to meet a woman who has revived an old tradition for making mustard balls, Prue has hacks for a mouthwatering burger sauce and a quick and healthy lunch using tinned sardines.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Crime drama series. The annual Thassingham Classical Music Festival draws in big audiences as several musicians anxiously compete for the coveted Falconer Bursary Award - shockwaves rocket though it when Jacob Wheeler is awarded the prize instead of the supremely talented Zac Sowande, but shock soon turns to horror when Jacob is found murdered strangled by violin string. Barnaby's initial investigations begin by focusing on Jacob's fellow musicians and their charismatic maestro Michael Falconer, who is using the festival to debut his Ninth Symphony while simultaneously belittling his own musician son Dan - when Barnaby realises that Jacob's Stradivarius is missing and that Jacob might not have been the completely dedicated musician his sister Natalie claims him to be, his subsequent investigations lead them deep into a world that is haunted by a potentially deadly curse.

programme.desc: The concluding part of a two-part documentary series. Detectives raid Luke D'Wit's home and seize a huge stash of prescription drugs - including fentanyl and antihistamine - that are both found in the Baxters' postmortem as police press Luke to explain his relationship to Carol Baxter's mysterious American physician Dr Andrea Bowden. As Ellena slowly realises that Luke has been a cuckoo in the family nest, detectives spend months combing through D'Wit's multiple digital devices to piece together the scale of his deception and cruelty.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue is joined by old friend Raymond Blanc as he cooks a chocolate mousse - he calls it 'Maman Blanc' as it's a recipe that came from his mother. It's also a cheesecake day for Prue as she makes a Basque burnt cheesecake and a no-bake lemon and ginger cheesecake. programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The concluding part of a two-part documentary series. Detectives raid Luke D'Wit's home and seize a huge stash of prescription drugs - including fentanyl and antihistamine - that are both found in the Baxters' postmortem as police press Luke to explain his relationship to Carol Baxter's mysterious American physician Dr Andrea Bowden. Luke has been mixing 'medicinal' drinks for Carol on Dr Bowden's instructions, but detectives can find no trace of her existence - meanwhile, Ellena Baxter is completely cleared of her parents' murders and agrees to be interviewed as a witness for the police. As Ellena slowly realises that Luke has been a cuckoo in the family nest, detectives spend months combing through D'Wit's multiple digital devices to piece together the scale of his deception and cruelty.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. Raheel Ahmad looked the perfect match for TikTok photographer Sania Khan on paper - he came from a good family and wanted to be a doctor, but Raheel couldn't pass his medical exams once the couple had gotten married and then tried to hurl himself and her from the window of their 28th-storey Chicago apartment just months after their huge wedding. Hospitalised with mental problems, Raheel admitted that he had lied about his age and had been unfaithful - Sania then went public on TikTok with her agonies over whether to stick by her man or request a divorce. Her honesty and growing self-reliance resonated with abused women around the world and sent shockwaves through the South Asian community in America - the couple separated, but Raheel started to plot his revenge as Sania's posts went viral.

programme.title: Fern Britton: Inside the Vet's
programme.desc: Fern Britton joins much-loved pets and their devoted owners behind the scenes at The Grove Vets, a busy family practice in the suburbs of Bristol run by husband-and-wife team Andy and Amy Valencia - in this episode, Fern helps the team as they manage a busy few days of operations and consultations. Vet James is concerned about British Shorthair cat Nico as he has a limp in his hind legs, Fern meets Cocker Spaniel Nya as she enters the surgery for a scan on a potentially cancerous lump, vet Amy is in theatre and performing an operation on Border Terrier Dobby to remove an undescended testicle, nervous Cockapoo Jobo has to undergo an operation to have a lump removed from his ear by vet Andy, and we head outside the practice to Bristol's Guide Dog Centre to see puppies in training.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: In Donegal Town, Dermot's journey takes him further south along the Wild Atlantic Way, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its beautifully flecked fabric. Dressed fit for a fine meal, Dermot visits one of Ireland's most unexpected culinary hotspots: Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house. He meets Bangladeshi-born chef Rana, and together they cook railway curry using outstanding local Donegal lamb and potatoes - it's a heaven-made match of Asian flavours and quality Irish produce. For pudding, Dermot meets chef Brian McDermott, one of the biggest champions of Donegal's food scene. Together they bake a classic Irish apple pie, with Brian revealing why all the local rain creates richer grass, creamier milk and extra buttery pastry, making Donegal Town a dessert destination.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue is joined by old friend Raymond Blanc as he cooks a chocolate mousse - he calls it 'Maman Blanc' as it's a recipe that came from his mother. It's also a cheesecake day for Prue as she makes a Basque burnt cheesecake and a no-bake lemon and ginger cheesecake. Prue's food hero this time is Bold Beans and a farmer who produces some of the peas for the company - Prue and John then use some of those peas to make Indian pancakes with a carlin pea saag and paneer, and John is very happy that Prue has saved him some cheesecake and some of Raymond's chocolate mousse! While John heads to Tewkesbury to meet a woman who has revived an old tradition for making mustard balls, Prue has hacks for a mouthwatering burger sauce and a quick and healthy lunch using tinned sardines.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Crime drama series. The annual Thassingham Classical Music Festival draws in big audiences as several musicians anxiously compete for the coveted Falconer Bursary Award - shockwaves rocket though it when Jacob Wheeler is awarded the prize instead of the supremely talented Zac Sowande, but shock soon turns to horror when Jacob is found murdered strangled by violin string. Barnaby's initial investigations begin by focusing on Jacob's fellow musicians and their charismatic maestro Michael Falconer, who is using the festival to debut his Ninth Symphony while simultaneously belittling his own musician son Dan - when Barnaby realises that Jacob's Stradivarius is missing and that Jacob might not have been the completely dedicated musician his sister Natalie claims him to be, his subsequent investigations lead them deep into a world that is haunted by a potentially deadly curse.

programme.title: Syd
programme.desc: Syd is the inspirational story of a man who never backed down from a challenge. As a cricketer, David 'Syd' Lawrence was a fearsome fast bowler, who reached the top of the game to become the first British-born Black player to represent England. Although his career was cut short by an injury, described as one of the worst in sporting history, his achievements off the field have to be seen to be believed. In this film by Sabet Choudhury, Syd's family and friends including Phil Tufnell, Jonathan Agnew, Jack Russell and Sir Viv Richards recount a story that shows what can be achieved with a strong will and pure determination.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: In Donegal Town, Dermot's journey takes him further south along the Wild Atlantic Way, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its beautifully flecked fabric. Dressed fit for a fine meal, Dermot visits one of Ireland's most unexpected culinary hotspots: Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house. He meets Bangladeshi-born chef Rana, and together they cook railway curry using outstanding local Donegal lamb and potatoes - it's a heaven-made match of Asian flavours and quality Irish produce. For pudding, Dermot meets chef Brian McDermott, one of the biggest champions of Donegal's food scene. Together they bake a classic Irish apple pie, with Brian revealing why all the local rain creates richer grass, creamier milk and extra buttery pastry, making Donegal Town a dessert destination.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue is joined by old friend Raymond Blanc as he cooks a chocolate mousse - he calls it 'Maman Blanc' as it's a recipe that came from his mother. It's also a cheesecake day for Prue as she makes a Basque burnt cheesecake and a no-bake lemon and ginger cheesecake. Prue's food hero this time is Bold Beans and a farmer who produces some of the peas for the company - Prue and John then use some of those peas to make Indian pancakes with a carlin pea saag and paneer, and John is very happy that Prue has saved him some cheesecake and some of Raymond's chocolate mousse! While John heads to Tewkesbury to meet a woman who has revived an old tradition for making mustard balls, Prue has hacks for a mouthwatering burger sauce and a quick and healthy lunch using tinned sardines.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Crime drama series. The annual Thassingham Classical Music Festival draws in big audiences as several musicians anxiously compete for the coveted Falconer Bursary Award - shockwaves rocket though it when Jacob Wheeler is awarded the prize instead of the supremely talented Zac Sowande, but shock soon turns to horror when Jacob is found murdered strangled by violin string. Barnaby's initial investigations begin by focusing on Jacob's fellow musicians and their charismatic maestro Michael Falconer, who is using the festival to debut his Ninth Symphony while simultaneously belittling his own musician son Dan - when Barnaby realises that Jacob's Stradivarius is missing and that Jacob might not have been the completely dedicated musician his sister Natalie claims him to be, his subsequent investigations lead them deep into a world that is haunted by a potentially deadly curse.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The concluding part of a two-part documentary series. Detectives raid Luke D'Wit's home and seize a huge stash of prescription drugs - including fentanyl and antihistamine - that are both found in the Baxters' postmortem as police press Luke to explain his relationship to Carol Baxter's mysterious American physician Dr Andrea Bowden. Luke has been mixing 'medicinal' drinks for Carol on Dr Bowden's instructions, but detectives can find no trace of her existence - meanwhile, Ellena Baxter is completely cleared of her parents' murders and agrees to be interviewed as a witness for the police. As Ellena slowly realises that Luke has been a cuckoo in the family nest, detectives spend months combing through D'Wit's multiple digital devices to piece together the scale of his deception and cruelty.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. Raheel Ahmad looked the perfect match for TikTok photographer Sania Khan on paper - he came from a good family and wanted to be a doctor, but Raheel couldn't pass his medical exams once the couple had gotten married and then tried to hurl himself and her from the window of their 28th-storey Chicago apartment just months after their huge wedding. Hospitalised with mental problems, Raheel admitted that he had lied about his age and had been unfaithful - Sania then went public on TikTok with her agonies over whether to stick by her man or request a divorce. Her honesty and growing self-reliance resonated with abused women around the world and sent shockwaves through the South Asian community in America - the couple separated, but Raheel started to plot his revenge as Sania's posts went viral.

Luke has been mixing 'medicinal' drinks for Carol on Dr Bowden's instructions, but detectives can find no trace of her existence - meanwhile, Ellena Baxter is completely cleared of her parents' murders and agrees to be interviewed as a witness for the police. As Ellena slowly realises that Luke has been a cuckoo in the family nest, detectives spend months combing through D'Wit's multiple digital devices to piece together the scale of his deception and cruelty.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. Raheel Ahmad looked the perfect match for TikTok photographer Sania Khan on paper - he came from a good family and wanted to be a doctor, but Raheel couldn't pass his medical exams once the couple had gotten married and then tried to hurl himself and her from the window of their 28th-storey Chicago apartment just months after their huge wedding. Hospitalised with mental problems, Raheel admitted that he had lied about his age and had been unfaithful - Sania then went public on TikTok with her agonies over whether to stick by her man or request a divorce. Her honesty and growing self-reliance resonated with abused women around the world and sent shockwaves through the South Asian community in America - the couple separated, but Raheel started to plot his revenge as Sania's posts went viral.

programme.title: Syd
programme.desc: Syd is the inspirational story of a man who never backed down from a challenge. As a cricketer, David 'Syd' Lawrence was a fearsome fast bowler, who reached the top of the game to become the first British-born Black player to represent England. Although his career was cut short by an injury, described as one of the worst in sporting history, his achievements off the field have to be seen to be believed. In this film by Sabet Choudhury, Syd's family and friends including Phil Tufnell, Jonathan Agnew, Jack Russell and Sir Viv Richards recount a story that shows what can be achieved with a strong will and pure determination.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: In Donegal Town, Dermot's journey takes him further south along the Wild Atlantic Way, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its beautifully flecked fabric. Dressed fit for a fine meal, Dermot visits one of Ireland's most unexpected culinary hotspots: Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house. He meets Bangladeshi-born chef Rana, and together they cook railway curry using outstanding local Donegal lamb and potatoes - it's a heaven-made match of Asian flavours and quality Irish produce. For pudding, Dermot meets chef Brian McDermott, one of the biggest champions of Donegal's food scene. Together they bake a classic Irish apple pie, with Brian revealing why all the local rain creates richer grass, creamier milk and extra buttery pastry, making Donegal Town a dessert destination.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue is joined by old friend Raymond Blanc as he cooks a chocolate mousse - he calls it 'Maman Blanc' as it's a recipe that came from his mother. It's also a cheesecake day for Prue as she makes a Basque burnt cheesecake and a no-bake lemon and ginger cheesecake. Prue's food hero this time is Bold Beans and a farmer who produces some of the peas for the company - Prue and John then use some of those peas to make Indian pancakes with a carlin pea saag and paneer, and John is very happy that Prue has saved him some cheesecake and some of Raymond's chocolate mousse! While John heads to Tewkesbury to meet a woman who has revived an old tradition for making mustard balls, Prue has hacks for a mouthwatering burger sauce and a quick and healthy lunch using tinned sardines.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Crime drama series. The annual Thassingham Classical Music Festival draws in big audiences as several musicians anxiously compete for the coveted Falconer Bursary Award - shockwaves rocket though it when Jacob Wheeler is awarded the prize instead of the supremely talented Zac Sowande, but shock soon turns to horror when Jacob is found murdered strangled by violin string. Barnaby's initial investigations begin by focusing on Jacob's fellow musicians and their charismatic maestro Michael Falconer, who is using the festival to debut his Ninth Symphony while simultaneously belittling his own musician son Dan - when Barnaby realises that Jacob's Stradivarius is missing and that Jacob might not have been the completely dedicated musician his sister Natalie claims him to be, his subsequent investigations lead them deep into a world that is haunted by a potentially deadly curse.

When the sudden deaths of the belligerent local GP Dr Humbleby and Honoria Waynflete's maid leave Reverend Wake busy with funeral services, Luke finds himself becoming Miss Marple's confidante and ally in the search for the truth. Before long the bereaved Jessie Humbleby loses her grip on reality, and Constable Reed turns to Miss Marple for guidance in the murky waters of his first murder case. Meanwhile, Endeavour receives a guest at home who reminds him of a past he'd sooner forget, and as the investigation into the cab driver's murder unfolds, Endeavour finds that the case is hitting too close to home. programme.title: Count Dracula
programme.desc: Part One. 1977. Drama. Directed by Philip Saville. Stars Louis Jourdan, Frank Finlay & Judi Bowker. A young solicitor travels to Transylvania, a journey that will change his life forever. [S]

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: Destination Nightmare. 1958. Stars Boris Karloff, Ron Hagerthy & Myron Healey. The son of an airline owner falls into a trance and nearly crashes, leading his father to confront wartime secrets. [S]

programme.title: 13 East Street
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Directed by Robert Baker. Starring Patrick Holt, Dora Bryan & Michael Balfour. A detective poses as an escaped convict to catch a gang of warehouse robbers. [S]

programme.title: Green Hornet Strikes Again
programme.desc: Crashing Barriers. 1941. Starring: Warren Hull. The crime syndicate are stealing cars and Brett Reid decides to take Axford and Miss Case to investigate when the trio are spotted and are captured. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Ugly Duckling. 1957. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. Sir Lancelot and Merlin on a visit to Lamorack help their host when is daughter is threatened. [S]

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. How Brilling, Obeamish Boy. Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and starring Anne Francis. A man kidnaps Sam for a ransom of a parcel that Honey has been hired to guard.

programme.title: Murder in Eden
programme.desc: 1961. Thriller. Director: Max Varnel. Stars: Ray McAnally, Catherine Feller, Yvonne Buckingham. After discovering a famous painting is a forgery, a noted art critic is killed by driver. [S]

programme.title: The Flaw
programme.desc: 1955. Crime directed by Terence Fisher. A racing driver (John Bentley) plans to murder his heiress wife (Rona Anderson). The lawyer (Donald Houston) discovers the plot. [S]

programme.title: Jack the Giant Killer
programme.desc: 1962. Fantasy. Directed by Nathan Juran. Stars Kerwin Mathews, Judi Meredith, & Torin Thatcher. The treacherous Pendragon plots to gain the throne of Cornwall. Can anyone stop the evil sorcerer? [S]

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Cabin in Beverly Hills. 1964. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Irene Ryan & Donna Douglas. Granny is homesick so Mr Drysdale has a replica made of Jed's old cabin as a surprise for her birthday. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: How to Hatch a Dinosaur. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Vincent Price. Egghead & Olga attempt to hatch an ancient Neosaurus egg and feed the baby dinosaur a meal of Batman, Robin and Batgirl. [S]

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: 1945. Adventure. Directed by Rowland V. Lee. Stars Charles Laughton, Randolph Scott & Barbara Britton. Pirate, Captain William Kidd, tricks the king to hire him as an escort to a treasure ship. [S]

programme.title: The Four Feathers (1978)
programme.desc: 1978. Drama. Directed by Don Sharp. Stars Beau Bridges, Robert Powell & Jane Seymour. Lieutenant Faversham dishonours his regiment and loses his fiancée, but can he regain his honour and his love? [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Musclemen
programme.desc: 1963. A look into the world of musclemen in the army, wrestling and weightlifting.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: The Widower. 1970. Stars Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Ada brings Walter home for the first time, for a fish and chip supper. (S1, E01) [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Love Affair. 1968. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. U.N.C.L.E investigates Brother Love, a religious figure who kidnaps leading scientists for a new Thrush operation. [S]

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: The Detectives have unearthed a brilliant road safety film, they take viewers to 1960s Northern Ireland to learn how to cook food for guests & there's some great detective work from viewers too. [S]

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick is considered one of the greatest and most influential directors in cinematic history. His cinematic masterpiece was to arrive in 1968 with the creation of 2001: A Space Odyssey. [S]

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Dirty Linen. 1984. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Jennifer Lonsdale. Ida finds a 'love letter' in Shane's pocket and everyone jumps to the same conclusion: he's having an affair. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: 30 Days to Die. 1953. Stars Hubert Gregg & Laurence Naismith. Following a bad review, a writer vows revenge on the critic and gives him a deadline to write him a new play. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of Albert Watson V.C. 1966. Stars John Barrie, Charles Morgan & Ronald Lacey. Sergeant Cork is taken hostage by Albert Watson, a man who received the Victoria Cross for bravery in India. [S]

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: 1976. Comedy. Stars Barry Evans, Judy Geeson & Diana Dors. Joe loves picking up dolly birds so his job as a cabbie is perfect! Forget 'south of the river', these beauties are going all the way! [S]

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Count Dracula
programme.desc: Part Two. 1977. Drama. Directed by Philip Saville. Stars Louis Jourdan, Frank Finlay & Susan Penhaligon. The Count flees back to his castle, will Harker be able to put an end to this nightmare? [S]

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: In Donegal Town, Dermot's journey takes him further south along the Wild Atlantic Way, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its beautifully flecked fabric. Dressed fit for a fine meal, Dermot visits one of Ireland's most unexpected culinary hotspots: Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house. He meets Bangladeshi-born chef Rana, and together they cook railway curry using outstanding local Donegal lamb and potatoes - it's a heaven-made match of Asian flavours and quality Irish produce. For pudding, Dermot meets chef Brian McDermott, one of the biggest champions of Donegal's food scene. Together they bake a classic Irish apple pie, with Brian revealing why all the local rain creates richer grass, creamier milk and extra buttery pastry, making Donegal Town a dessert destination.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue is joined by old friend Raymond Blanc as he cooks a chocolate mousse - he calls it 'Maman Blanc' as it's a recipe that came from his mother. It's also a cheesecake day for Prue as she makes a Basque burnt cheesecake and a no-bake lemon and ginger cheesecake. Prue's food hero this time is Bold Beans and a farmer who produces some of the peas for the company - Prue and John then use some of those peas to make Indian pancakes with a carlin pea saag and paneer, and John is very happy that Prue has saved him some cheesecake and some of Raymond's chocolate mousse! While John heads to Tewkesbury to meet a woman who has revived an old tradition for making mustard balls, Prue has hacks for a mouthwatering burger sauce and a quick and healthy lunch using tinned sardines.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Crime drama series. The annual Thassingham Classical Music Festival draws in big audiences as several musicians anxiously compete for the coveted Falconer Bursary Award - shockwaves rocket though it when Jacob Wheeler is awarded the prize instead of the supremely talented Zac Sowande, but shock soon turns to horror when Jacob is found murdered strangled by violin string. Barnaby's initial investigations begin by focusing on Jacob's fellow musicians and their charismatic maestro Michael Falconer, who is using the festival to debut his Ninth Symphony while simultaneously belittling his own musician son Dan - when Barnaby realises that Jacob's Stradivarius is missing and that Jacob might not have been the completely dedicated musician his sister Natalie claims him to be, his subsequent investigations lead them deep into a world that is haunted by a potentially deadly curse.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The concluding part of a two-part documentary series. Detectives raid Luke D'Wit's home and seize a huge stash of prescription drugs - including fentanyl and antihistamine - that are both found in the Baxters' postmortem as police press Luke to explain his relationship to Carol Baxter's mysterious American physician Dr Andrea Bowden. Luke has been mixing 'medicinal' drinks for Carol on Dr Bowden's instructions, but detectives can find no trace of her existence - meanwhile, Ellena Baxter is completely cleared of her parents' murders and agrees to be interviewed as a witness for the police. As Ellena slowly realises that Luke has been a cuckoo in the family nest, detectives spend months combing through D'Wit's multiple digital devices to piece together the scale of his deception and cruelty.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. Raheel Ahmad looked the perfect match for TikTok photographer Sania Khan on paper - he came from a good family and wanted to be a doctor, but Raheel couldn't pass his medical exams once the couple had gotten married and then tried to hurl himself and her from the window of their 28th-storey Chicago apartment just months after their huge wedding. Hospitalised with mental problems, Raheel admitted that he had lied about his age and had been unfaithful - Sania then went public on TikTok with her agonies over whether to stick by her man or request a divorce. Her honesty and growing self-reliance resonated with abused women around the world and sent shockwaves through the South Asian community in America - the couple separated, but Raheel started to plot his revenge as Sania's posts went viral.

programme.title: Syd
programme.desc: Syd is the inspirational story of a man who never backed down from a challenge. As a cricketer, David 'Syd' Lawrence was a fearsome fast bowler, who reached the top of the game to become the first British-born Black player to represent England. Although his career was cut short by an injury, described as one of the worst in sporting history, his achievements off the field have to be seen to be believed. In this film by Sabet Choudhury, Syd's family and friends including Phil Tufnell, Jonathan Agnew, Jack Russell and Sir Viv Richards recount a story that shows what can be achieved with a strong will and pure determination.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The concluding part of a two-part documentary series. Detectives raid Luke D'Wit's home and seize a huge stash of prescription drugs - including fentanyl and antihistamine - that are both found in the Baxters' postmortem as police press Luke to explain his relationship to Carol Baxter's mysterious American physician Dr Andrea Bowden. Luke has been mixing 'medicinal' drinks for Carol on Dr Bowden's instructions, but detectives can find no trace of her existence - meanwhile, Ellena Baxter is completely cleared of her parents' murders and agrees to be interviewed as a witness for the police. As Ellena slowly realises that Luke has been a cuckoo in the family nest, detectives spend months combing through D'Wit's multiple digital devices to piece together the scale of his deception and cruelty.

programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral
programme.desc: With exclusive access to the victims' families, friends and the police, this documentary strand explores extraordinary true crime cases linked to the world's fastest-growing social media platform. Raheel Ahmad looked the perfect match for TikTok photographer Sania Khan on paper - he came from a good family and wanted to be a doctor, but Raheel couldn't pass his medical exams once the couple had gotten married and then tried to hurl himself and her from the window of their 28th-storey Chicago apartment just months after their huge wedding. Hospitalised with mental problems, Raheel admitted that he had lied about his age and had been unfaithful - Sania then went public on TikTok with her agonies over whether to stick by her man or request a divorce. Her honesty and growing self-reliance resonated with abused women around the world and sent shockwaves through the South Asian community in America - the couple separated, but Raheel started to plot his revenge as Sania's posts went viral.

Vet James is concerned about British Shorthair cat Nico as he has a limp in his hind legs, Fern meets Cocker Spaniel Nya as she enters the surgery for a scan on a potentially cancerous lump, vet Amy is in theatre and performing an operation on Border Terrier Dobby to remove an undescended testicle, nervous Cockapoo Jobo has to undergo an operation to have a lump removed from his ear by vet Andy, and we head outside the practice to Bristol's Guide Dog Centre to see puppies in training.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: In Donegal Town, Dermot's journey takes him further south along the Wild Atlantic Way, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its beautifully flecked fabric. Dressed fit for a fine meal, Dermot visits one of Ireland's most unexpected culinary hotspots: Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house. He meets Bangladeshi-born chef Rana, and together they cook railway curry using outstanding local Donegal lamb and potatoes - it's a heaven-made match of Asian flavours and quality Irish produce. For pudding, Dermot meets chef Brian McDermott, one of the biggest champions of Donegal's food scene. Together they bake a classic Irish apple pie, with Brian revealing why all the local rain creates richer grass, creamier milk and extra buttery pastry, making Donegal Town a dessert destination.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue is joined by old friend Raymond Blanc as he cooks a chocolate mousse - he calls it 'Maman Blanc' as it's a recipe that came from his mother. It's also a cheesecake day for Prue as she makes a Basque burnt cheesecake and a no-bake lemon and ginger cheesecake. Prue's food hero this time is Bold Beans and a farmer who produces some of the peas for the company - Prue and John then use some of those peas to make Indian pancakes with a carlin pea saag and paneer, and John is very happy that Prue has saved him some cheesecake and some of Raymond's chocolate mousse! While John heads to Tewkesbury to meet a woman who has revived an old tradition for making mustard balls, Prue has hacks for a mouthwatering burger sauce and a quick and healthy lunch using tinned sardines.

programme.title: Syd
programme.desc: Syd is the inspirational story of a man who never backed down from a challenge. As a cricketer, David 'Syd' Lawrence was a fearsome fast bowler, who reached the top of the game to become the first British-born Black player to represent England. Although his career was cut short by an injury, described as one of the worst in sporting history, his achievements off the field have to be seen to be believed. In this film by Sabet Choudhury, Syd's family and friends including Phil Tufnell, Jonathan Agnew, Jack Russell and Sir Viv Richards recount a story that shows what can be achieved with a strong will and pure determination.
